Doubao Seedance 2.5 260628 Global Task Status

GEThttps://api.modelverse.cn/v1/tasks/status
v1.0.0
OpenAPI 3.1.0

ModelVerse doubao-seedance-2-5-260628-global Video Task API

OpenAPI 3.1 schema for the ModelVerse doubao-seedance-2-5-260628-global asynchronous video generation task API. Covers submitting a task, querying task status, and cancelling a task (GET /v1/tasks/cancel).

Server:https://api.modelverse.cn

ModelVerse API key sent as Authorization: Bearer <MODELVERSE_API_KEY>.

:
Client Libraries
Shell Curl

doubao-seedance-2-5-260628-global

​

Asynchronous video task operations for doubao-seedance-2-5-260628-global.

doubao-seedance-2-5-260628-global Operations
  • get/v1/tasks/status

Doubao Seedance 2.5 260628 Global Task Status

​

Query the status, result URLs, and usage details for an asynchronous video task.

Query Parameters
  • task_id
    Type: string
    required

    Asynchronous task identifier returned by /v1/tasks/submit.

Responses
  • application/json
  • application/json
  • application/json
Request Example for get/v1/tasks/status
curl 'https://api.modelverse.cn/v1/tasks/status?task_id=task_id' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_TOKEN'

{
  "output": {
    "task_id": "xxxxxxx",
    "task_status": "Success",
    "urls": [
      "http://xxxxxxxx/xx.mp4"
    ],
    "submit_time": 1768460826,
    "finish_time": 1768460932
  },
  "usage": {
    "completion_tokens": 108900,
    "total_tokens": 108900,
    "duration": 5
  },
  "request_id": ""
}
